Ironclad Democracy Releases
Ironclad Democracy
Info
Release Date
September 22nd, 2026
Cost
1,000 Super Credits
Credits Claimable
300 Super Credits

Ironclad Democracy is a Premium Warbond available for 1,000 Super Credits in the Warbonds tab of the Acquisition Center.

Contents

  • 1 Overview
  • 2 Contents
    • 2.1 Page 1
    • 2.2 Page 2

Overview

Players can use Medals to claim various items. These rewards are spread across three pages, each requiring increasingly more Medals (ranging from 2 to 110). Players start on page one, unlocking subsequent pages as they spend more Medals, gradually expanding their customization options.

Trivia

  • Ironclad Democracy is the first Premium Warbond to feature two Boosters. It is also the first Premium Warbond since Freedom's Flame to feature no new Stratagems.
